title: Prefill burst policy with a concurrency-proportional decode-row bound: 5-pair qualification (Qwen3-4B, A100 GPU7)
registered: 2026-10-22 KST, before any arm of this experiment
motivation: The K=10 qualification (burst-qualification-preregistration.json) missed its primary target (fixed C32 TTFT p95 -8.97% vs <= -10%) and regressed C8 cells outside its gate: fixed C8 TTFT p95 +8.36%, fixed C8 ITL p99 +39.7%, natural C8 ITL p99 +76.3%, because at C8 decode rows never exceed K=10.

binaries.candidate: riley-phase1-v4 (v3 + --prefill-burst-max-decode-percent; scheduler unchanged) with native-burst-p31.json: budget 512, chunk 512, buckets to 512, steady budget 256, max decode rows = ceil(31% x max active sequences) = 1/3/5/10 at C1/C8/C16/C32

choice_of_percent: 31 keeps K=10 at C32 (the best C32 TTFT p95 among the rule-passing K in the earlier screen) and scales it down at lower concurrency; chosen from the earlier screen before this experiment, not tuned on it. The C32 policy is therefore identical to the failed K=10 candidate.
cells: fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32, 5 fresh pairs each, 64 warm + 192 measured, runner order alternation

question_1_c8_fix.pass_if: fixed C8 and natural C8: median-of-5 paired TTFT p95 change <= +2% and ITL p99 change <= +5%

question_2_adoption_gate_unchanged.primary: fixed C32 TTFT p95: median-of-5 paired change <= -10%
question_2_adoption_gate_unchanged.tail_bounds: every cell TPOT p99 <= +10%; fixed C32 candidate ITL p99 median <= 27.0 ms
question_2_adoption_gate_unchanged.correctness: native canonical outputs measured 192/192 in every arm, no cross-concurrency mismatch
question_2_adoption_gate_unchanged.note: Unchanged from the K=10 registration; because the C32 policy is identical, the primary may again fall short. It is not relaxed.

reporting: All pairs and metrics reported; nothing excluded or repeated
decision: Adopt as the recommended Qwen3-4B native configuration only if question 2 passes; question 1 alone shows whether the proportional bound removes the C8 regression
